newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: TABLE - FCL Paper reports NZ$50 mln yr loss.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - FCL Paper reports NZ$50 mln yr loss.

text.p: Fletcher Paper yr result to June 30:

Note - Market expectations for FCL Paper were for a loss, before abnormal gains, of around NZ$60-70 million. Unusual items brought the total reported loss to NZ$385 million. The items comprised a NZ$400 million provision for the carrying values

of UK Paper's assets, the government's NZ$30 million payment to buy out its indemnity in respect of fibre supply to Tasman's Kawerau mill, the restructuring provision recorded by the Canadian operations and a NZ$43 million net gain on the sale of the TimberWest holding. No dividend was recommended. FCL Paper said in May that the recent distribution of Forests Division shares to the Paper Division shareholders would be in lieu of a final cash dividend.
